reviews.author: Jessica Hilario
reviews.text:
Got my nails done here (gel polish) and also tried the Olaplex Treatment for my hair, which turned out really nice.

I highly recommend Sabina if you’re getting a manicure—she’s very light-handed, polished my nails beautifully, and even took care of the dry skin. For pedicures, Sital did a great job shaping my nails exactly how I wanted. Both of them also followed my request for just 2 coats of gel polish, which I really appreciated. 🤣😁

For the owner, I’d like to suggest investing in a proper nail area where customers can sit comfortably. I had to sit on a haircut chair during my manicure, which was uncomfortable, especially when curing my gel polish with the UV device just sitting on my lap. 😅

I also want to give special mention to the lovely African lady working outside—she’s so hardworking, even in 40-degree heat, bringing customers in. She truly deserves recognition (and a raise!).

Overall, it was a very nice experience, and I’d definitely recommend visiting.
reviews.owner_reply:
Hi Ms. Jessica! 😊

Thank you so much for your wonderful feedback! We’re so happy to hear you enjoyed your manicure with Sabina and pedicure with Sital. 💅✨ We’ll definitely share your kind words with them—they’ll be thrilled!

We really appreciate your suggestion about the seating area. Rest assured, on your next visit, you’ll find chairs that are much more comfortable for you! 🪑👍

Also, thank you for recognizing our hardworking team member Jenny outside—she truly works so hard under the sun! ☀️👏

Thanks again for recommending Primera Beauty Salon. We can’t wait to see you again soon for another relaxing pampering session! 💖

Warmest regards,
Primera Beauty Salon Team
